report_body:
# Pane titlebar view switch — executor handoff

Task: `/tmp/bboxy-oracle-takeover-01M6H97SAX3GN1BYB4YG76P3P0/EXECUTOR-VIEW-SWITCH.md` plus parent base override to signed `986ff0a72f45547643c0314c2b7226356f9c0c75`.
Worktree: `/Users/feral/mydev/bboxy450-term-workspace-fix`; branch `codex-view-switch-20261104`. Earlier branches preserved. Parent handles integration/build/activation; no production process, bundle, owner, install or backend actions by this executor.

Mechanism:
- `crates/bbt-ui/src/modules/strip.rs:117` supplies an optional target-view enum and compact 20px toolkit pill immediately beside mute. On eligible panes only, the identity/title/notice area shrinks and clips before the reserved controls; ordinary strips keep their existing structure.
- `crates/bboxy450-term/src/rich_faces.rs:61` uses the prior live bboxy450-harness eligibility and current/default saved face to supply Terminal/Harness targets. `:78` routes the same preference/sync/IME/redraw action. The body-relative floating paint and hit rectangle are removed; rich fallback paint and generation/session/socket fencing remain in their existing path.
- `crates/bboxy450-term/src/main.rs:7773` is the one directly required scene/header glue line: project current local preferences before solving. `scene.rs:264,324,792,1715` includes targets in the geometry-cache key and supplies the actual pane strip. `scene/navigation.rs:109` derives header hit bounds from the solved toolkit node. `navigation.rs:462` dispatches its existing-style semantic navigation action.
- `scene/navigation.rs:139` checks 200/320/800px single and three-pane layouts, both target labels, long names/titles, shortcut and interrupt notice, identity/control/mute separation, vertical alignment, transcript separation, actual hit routing and no control for the ordinary pane.
- `rich_faces.rs:421` drives the native App pointer path in a private isolated UI fixture, toggles both directions, rejects an ordinary seat, checks no PTY/backend command from either click, keeps unavailable-rich fallback and IME ownership, and captures explicit Terminal preference through the existing WindowState path.

Verification (actual exits):
- `CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG=0 CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 make verify-view-switch` — **0**; `view_switch_titlebar_pointer_action_and_saved_preference` and `view_switch_header_geometry_and_hits` both pass, then existing `rich_keys_and_face_preference_do_not_reach_the_pty` passes. Actual output: `/tmp/bboxy-view-switch-evidence/verify-final.log` (2 + 1 selected tests, 0 failed). Geometry matrix: `/tmp/bboxy-view-switch-evidence/geometry.json`, 18 eligible-pane observations across the twelve layouts. Narrow Terminal control is 54.97×20px, separated from mute by 8px; Harness is 53.58×20px.
- `CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG=0 CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 make check-view-switch` — **0**; `cargo clippy --no-deps --locked -p bboxy450-ui --lib -p bboxy450-term --bin bboxy450-term ... -- -D warnings`. Actual output: `/tmp/bboxy-view-switch-evidence/check-final.log`. This is affected UI/App strict compilation, not all-workspace/all-test-target Clippy.
- `make format-view-switch` and `git diff --check` — **0**.
- Initial `/tmp/bboxy-view-switch-evidence/verify.log` — Make **2**, Cargo **101**, three compile diagnostics (private hit-helper path and Arc slice iteration). Fixed both source causes; `/tmp/bboxy-view-switch-evidence/verify-2.log` then passed the two new tests. These are development compile failures, not a behavioral baseline/control proof.

Evidence per acceptance:
- Header placement/compactness/nonoverlap — solved `pane/strip/view` toolkit node immediately before mute; matrix assertions keep its rect inside pane, above body, horizontally clear of identity and mute, centered vertically with mute. The clipped identity includes optional shortcut/interrupt notice so they cannot paint beneath the reserved actions.
- Correct label/action — matrix checks both actual rendered text values while exercising cached layout target changes; native App fixture clicks actual solved navigation bounds Harness→Terminal and Terminal→Harness with explicit preference checks after each action.
- Eligible-only/non-harness — live-kind filter is unchanged; ordinary seat has no target/hit/control and its direct action refuses preference mutation.
- Persistence/input/fallback/generation — WindowState captures explicit Terminal; both click actions queue no backend/PTY command, existing rich-key preference regression passes; unavailable-rich fallback remains painted and IME stays rich-owned; existing socket/session/generation synchronization code is untouched. This is not a new live reconnect/generation-replacement proof.
- Operational preservation — tests use only in-memory synthetic model and private isolated native UI child. No application install, production process signal or backend/socket control. Work staged for parent review/activation only.

Omissions: no full test/test-parity/formal suites, GPU screenshot or live installation. This is geometry/header/action work under the explicit focused-check brief; prior formal/runtime evidence is not claimed refreshed. No new backend/protocol/lifecycle behavior.
activation: staged only; parent owns integration, build and strict preserve-backend activation
